name: MonitoringSDK
description:
MonitoringSDK is a lightweight, enterprise-grade monitoring SDK for iOS applications.

Features include:
- Structured Logging
- Network Monitoring (URLSession)
- Navigation Tracking
- Session Tracking
- Crash Reporting
- Built-in Monitoring Dashboard
- Search & Filtering
- JSON Response Viewer

Built with Swift 6 and supports both UIKit and SwiftUI.
